dataset: Nursing Career Awareness - higher-study career pathway demo dataset
notes: Per-record source metadata is normalised: use source_ids to join to sources[] (PostgreSQL: career_records.source_ids -> sources.source_id).
'Not verified from an authoritative source.' marks fields not found; no gaps were filled by assumption.
'interpretation' is kept apart from the sourced facts in other fields.
Progression edges are 'possible pathway' only; none is automatic.

gaps.description: Almost all sources were read as search-result extracts, not full documents; page numbers are mostly not captured and some notices are truncated.
gaps.action: Open each source URL and fill page/section before ingestion; promote confidence only after full read.

gaps.description: INC original documents for M.Sc, faculty norms (F.No.1-6/2018-INC) and NPCC were read only through university copies.
gaps.action: Download from indiannursingcouncil.org and replace SRC-001/002/005.

gaps.description: M.Sc experience: INC-derived copies and TN DME require 1 year after Basic B.Sc; MAHER (TN deemed university) states B.Sc nurses can be admitted right after graduation.
gaps.action: Check the current INC M.Sc regulation and the TN DME prospectus for the target year; record institution-specific variation.

gaps.description: Post Basic B.Sc experience: none (Sri Ramachandra), 1 year (SBVU KG), 2 years (SBVU admissions page).
gaps.action: Find INC Post Basic B.Sc regulation; store as institution-specific if still divergent.

gaps.description: INC-derived M.Sc copies: examiner experience 3 years after M.Sc (several) vs 4 years (DPU copy).
gaps.action: Resolve against INC text and note version/year.

gaps.description: Ph.D. research guide: INC 2024 regulation says 5 years PG teaching + publications; consortium prospectus says 3 years M.Sc(N) teaching after Ph.D.
gaps.action: Read both documents fully; may be different contexts.

gaps.description: Faculty experience norms differ between an older INC staffing text (Reader: 7 years/3 teaching) and the 2018-based table (Associate Professor: 8/5); employers (KINS) set stricter values.
gaps.action: Treat the 2018 table as likely current but verify; keep employer values separate.

gaps.description: No Tamil Nadu government recruitment notification for nursing faculty (Assistant Professor / Tutor), Nursing Superintendent, public-health nursing (DPH/NHM) or Nursing Officer by MRB after 2019 was retrieved.
gaps.action: Search mrb.tn.gov.in, tnhealth.tn.gov.in and TN gazette (Principal, College of Nursing adhoc rules were seen in gazette index but not read).

gaps.description: UK NMC: IELTS/OET score levels, fees and number of OSCE test centres were not verified from NMC pages (secondary sources disagree). NMBA: India's qualification category not verified.
gaps.action: Read NMC English-language and Test-of-Competence pages and the NMBA assessment pages.

gaps.description: MNS (Army), PGIMER research nurse, Manipal admin roles, Mother Terasa College and NORCET-9 rest on Tier 5 sources.
gaps.action: Replace with official joinindianarmy.nic.in, PGIMER, Manipal and college notices.

gaps.description: Most pay figures are level/scale only; rupee basic pay for NORCET Level 7 and AIIMS ANS/DNS/NS/CNO was not captured from official extracts. Private pay appears only in the HIMSR notice (Rs 35,000-40,000/month, 2025) and a 2020 PGIMER report.
gaps.action: Add 7th CPC pay-matrix source; do not present private figures as typical.

gaps.description: Sources suggest gender-specific restrictions: MNS SSC reported female-only; AIIMS Raipur iKMC research nurse female-only; a 2011 CMC Vellore PG notice (secondary) barred male candidates from OBG/Community Health M.Sc; NORCET extracts show no gender bar.
gaps.action: Verify each on official sources and the current INC position before the project makes any statement about men in nursing.

gaps.description: No notification was found that requires a specific M.Sc speciality for a non-faculty clinical post; no sourced evidence that NPCC is a required qualification for any post.
